messages:
morgan: FYI release cut is blocked. Several promote jobs are failing with 404 on artifact fetch from internal-registry after promotion prepare. Looks like replication lag or a partial upload.

build-bot: [CI] promote-artifact/job #128 failed  artifact-fetch: GET https://artifacts.redwood/internal/v1/sha/abc123 -> 404 Not Found. Full logs: https://ci.redwood/128 :warning:

joan: We're seeing the same across three different shards. The artifact was uploaded ~30s before the promote step started. Could be replication not finished between regions.

infra-bot: Notice: object-store replication lag detected between us-east and eu-west clusters. Recent control-plane job queue spike at 1748123200 correlated with increased put ops. Estimated catch-up: ~4-7 minutes. Suggested mitigations: (1) re-fetch from local primary, (2) re-upload artifact to eu-west mirror, (3) hold promotion.

sam: Recommendation: hold the window for 10m, attempt re-mirror to eu-west, and add a short retry/backoff in the promote job to prefer primary then mirror. If still 404 after 10m, pin to previous-good artifact and proceed. Thoughts?

morgan: +1 to hold + try mirror. We must avoid skipping promotes silently. Update release ticket to reflect hold and threshold for pin.

joan: I'll trigger a targeted mirror job now: mirror-artifact --src us-east --dst eu-west --sha abc123. Attaching output.

```
mirrord: starting mirror for abc123
copy: ok (size 42MB)
registering: ok
```

build-bot: Retry: promote-artifact/job #129 queued  fetching from eu-west mirror.

deploy-bot: [CI] promote-artifact/job #129 failed  still 404 when contacting eu-west mirror gateway. Error: upstream cache returned miss.

joan: Weird. Mirror registration seemed fine. Checking object metadata and permissions...

infra-bot: Action: permissions audit shows a transient ACL update race; the mirror object's ACL wasn't set to public-read during registration window. Fix applied.

build-bot: promote-artifact/job #130 queued with additional retry (5 attempts, 30s backoff).

morgan: If job #130 still fails, we need to decide quickly: pin to last-good (sha def456) or wait another 10m. Release manager, what's the customer-facing risk?

sam: Deferring will push the release by ~20-30m total. No external customer freeze but internal launch timeline slips. PM is on standby; they prefer waiting if safety checks run, otherwise pin.

build-bot: promote-artifact/job #130 succeeded  artifact abc123 fetched from eu-west mirror after ACL fix.

morgan: Excellent. Unholding manual promotion in 5m after final smoke. I'll add a note to release notes: "brief hold due to artifact replication/ACL race; mirrored reupload succeeded; release proceeded after validation." Tagging @pm.

joan: Follow-up ticket: add mirror-registration sanity check and ensure mirror copy ACL is set within the same transaction as registration. Filed: INFRA-1921.

deploy-bot: [CI] promote completed  release promoted to staging. Leaving thread open for 30m for post-promote observability checks.
